dedupe_keys.name: sea ports by country humanitarian openstreetmap team on hdx

description: Sea Ports by country (Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team, on HDX) is a series of datasets listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT). Sea ports, harbours and ferry terminals. Useful for maritime logistics, supply-chain analysis, and coastal access planning. Coverage reflects where volunteer mappers have been active. Urban areas are usually well represented, remote areas may be sparse. Cross-check critical decisions with local field knowledge. Coverage: 234 countries and territories, one dataset each (for example Andorra, United Arab Emirates, Afghanistan, Antigua and Barbuda). The portal lists 235 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT). Its tags are facilities-infrastructure, geodata, ports. It offers 11 resource(s) in GEOJSON, GEOPACKAGE, HTML, JSON, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-07 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODC-ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
